_comment: Who speaks the German of the kaernten village (companion/README.md, Voice): the same archetypes as companion/voice-cast.json, for the kaernten cast (villagers/*.json 'speaker'). The bridge asks ElevenLabs (its model, LANI_ELEVENLABS_MODEL: eleven_v4_turbo by default) with language_code de. Chosen by audition on 2026-09-27: the same villager lines in each candidate, checked with the local Whisper (every word right), the pitch and the noise measured. Native Austrian library voices for the narrator and the old men (Fiona, Helmut: on the account since the audition, no voice slot); the others are voices the account had, which ElevenLabs verified in German where it says so (Mila, Daniel, Lily, Matilda, Jessica, Brian, Chris Basetta, Torri Miles; not Kavya). The male narrator Daniel is an English voice: 'carrier', so he says a lone word inside 'Das Wort ist: …'. 'alternatives': the other candidates heard (on the account); one with a 'library_owner' was not heard, only its library preview, and must be added first. To swap a voice, put its id in 'elevenlabs' and re-voice that speaker: LANI_CULTURE=kaernten companion/bin/voice-build --run --revoice <speaker> --data <the learner's data dir>. No 'gepard' voices: the local worker speaks only Slovene. Voice Design stays off for new profiles (LANI_VOICE_DESIGN=off).

denoise._comment: The girl's voice (Torri Miles) hisses: her ElevenLabs clips are filtered before they are stored (companion/voice-cast.json). So are the learner's voices whose library previews had their pauses above −58 dB (2026-10-29: 'players'); measure their first clips and take a filter away where it isn't needed.

player._comment: The grown-ups' default voice for the learner's own lines in a dialog, per gender: the first of 'players' (see its comment), which a learner without a choice hears; the cast's voice for a learner of a town older than 'players' on a visit.

players._comment: The voices the learner chooses theirs from, "🗣️ Moj glas · My voice" (companion/SCENES.md, "The learner's voice"; docs/plans/05-built/my-voice.md): a gender → an age (adult; child, for a learner whose profile is a child's: LANI_CHILD) → 2 or 3 voices, the default first. Each is a speaker below with its 'age' (a voice of the learner's: no villager may speak with it), or a narrator's voice in a language ('male.sl'). None may be a voice anyone in this cast speaks with (every speaker but the narrators and these, in every language): the bridge leaves such an entry out and logs it, and the smoke test fails on one. The learner's choice is kept in their learner profile (preferences.my_voice); a voice swapped here keeps its speaker, so their choice stays (set its 'since'). Picked from the ElevenLabs voice library on 2026-10-29 by their labels and their free previews (pitch, loudness, noise, the local Whisper), not heard by a learner yet; each speaker's 'role' says why. The first request with a library voice's id adds it to the account (no voice slot).
